text: But the rule holds with but slight exceptions that, whether warriors or priests, the upper classes are exempt from industrial employments, and this exemption is the economic expression of their superior rank.
zh: 但除了轻微的例外，这条规则仍然适用，无论是武士还是牧师，上层阶级都可以免于工业就业，而这种豁免是他们优越地位的经济表现。
chunks: But the rule holds with but slight exceptions that,
whether warriors or priests,
the upper classes are exempt from industrial employments,
and this exemption is the economic expression
of their superior rank.

text: These non-industrial upper-class occupations may be roughly comprised under government, warfare, religious observances, and sports.
zh: 这些非工业的上层阶级职业可能大致包括政府、战争、宗教仪式和体育运动。
chunks: These non-industrial upper-class occupations may be roughly comprised
under government, warfare,
religious observances,
and sports.

text: Manual labour, industry, whatever has to do directly with the everyday work of getting a livelihood, is the exclusive occupation of the inferior class.
zh: 体力劳动、工业，以及任何与日常谋生直接相关的工作，都是下层阶级的专属职业。
chunks: Manual labour, industry, whatever has
to do directly with the everyday work
of getting a livelihood,
is the exclusive occupation
of the inferior class.

text: As on the higher plane already spoken of, these employments are government, warfare, religious observances, and sports.
zh: 正如已经提到的更高层次上的那样，这些职业是政府、战争、宗教仪式和体育。
chunks: As on the higher plane already spoken
of,
these employments are government, warfare,
religious observances,
and sports.

text: Nomadic hunting tribes in various parts of the world illustrate these more primitive phases of the differentiation.
zh: 世界各地的游牧狩猎部落说明了这些更原始的分化阶段。
chunks: Nomadic hunting tribes
in various parts of the world illustrate these more primitive phases of the differentiation.

text: In nearly all these tribes the women are, by prescriptive custom, held to those employments out of which the industrial occupations proper develop at the next advance.
zh: 在几乎所有这些部落中，按照规定的习俗，妇女都从事那些在下一步发展中适当发展工业职业的工作。
chunks: In nearly all these tribes the women are,
by prescriptive custom,
held to those employments out of
which the industrial occupations proper develop
at the next advance.

text: In the later development it survives only in employments that are not classed as industrial,--war, politics, sports, learning, and the priestly office.
zh: 在后来的发展中，它只存在于不属于工业的职业中——战争、政治、体育、学术和牧师职位。
chunks: In the later development it survives only
in employments
that are not classed
as industrial, --war, politics, sports, learning,
and the priestly office.

text: Indeed, so obvious is this "productive" character of the men's work that in the conventional economic writings the hunter's work is taken as the type of primitive industry.
zh: 事实上，人类工作的这种“生产性”特征是如此明显，以至于在传统的经济学著作中，狩猎者的工作被视为原始工业的类型。
chunks: Indeed,
so obvious is this "productive" character
of the men's work
that in the conventional economic writings the hunter's work is taken
as the type of primitive industry.

text: Unequivocal instances of a primitive savage culture are hard to find.
zh: 原始野蛮文化的明确实例很难找到。
chunks: Unequivocal instances
of a primitive savage culture are hard to find.

text: Andamans, or by the Todas of the Nilgiri Hills.
zh: 安达曼群岛，或尼尔吉里山的托达人。
chunks: Andamans,
or by the Todas
of the Nilgiri Hills.

text: These communities that are without a defined leisure class resemble one another also in certain other features of their social structure and manner of life.
zh: 这些没有明确的休闲阶层的社区在其社会结构和生活方式的某些其他特征上也彼此相似。
chunks: These communities that are
without a defined leisure class resemble one another also
in certain other features
of their social structure
and manner of life.

text: The institution of leisure class is the outgrowth of an early discrimination between employments, according to which some employments are worthy and others unworthy.
zh: 有闲阶级制度是早期就业歧视的产物，根据这种歧视，有些工作值得，有些则不值得。
chunks: The institution of leisure class is the outgrowth
of an early discrimination
between employments, according to
which some employments are worthy
and others unworthy.

text: In the earlier stages of culture, when the personal force of the individual counted more immediately and obviously in shaping the course of events, the element of exploit counted for more in the everyday scheme of life.
zh: 在文化的早期阶段，当个人的个人力量在塑造事件进程时更加直接和明显地发挥作用时，剥削的因素在日常生活中发挥着更大的作用。
chunks: In the earlier stages of culture, when the personal force
of the individual counted more immediately
and obviously in shaping the course
of events, the element of exploit counted for more
in the everyday scheme of life.

text: Those features of the facts at hand are salient and substantial upon which the dominant interest of the time throws its light.
chunks: Those features of the facts
at hand are salient
and substantial
upon which the dominant interest
of the time throws its light.

text: But the change of standards and points of view is gradual only, and it seldom results in the subversion or entire suppression of a standpoint once accepted.
zh: 但标准和观点的改变只是渐进的，很少会导致曾经接受的立场被颠覆或完全压制。
chunks: But the change of standards and points
of view is gradual only,
and it seldom results
in the subversion or entire suppression
of a standpoint once accepted.

text: The coercive utilisation of man by man is not felt to be an industrial function; but all effort directed to enhance human life by taking advantage of the non-human environment is classed together as industrial activity.
zh: 人对人的强制利用不被认为是一种工业功能；但是，所有旨在通过利用非人类环境来改善人类生活的努力都被归为工业活动。
chunks: The coercive utilisation of man by man is not felt
to be an industrial function; but all effort directed
to enhance human life by taking advantage
of the non-human environment is classed together
as industrial activity.

text: There is a felt antithesis between economic and non-economic phenomena, but it is not conceived in the modern fashion; it lies not between man and brute creation, but between animate and inert things.
zh: 经济现象和非经济现象之间存在明显的对立，但现代时尚并没有这种对立。它不是介于人和动物之间，而是介于有生命和无生命的事物之间。
chunks: There is a felt antithesis
between economic and non-economic phenomena,
but it is not conceived in the modern fashion;
it lies not between man
and brute creation, but between animate and inert things.

text: The concept includes such things as in the apprehension of the animistic savage or barbarian are formidable by virtue of a real or imputed habit of initiating action.
zh: 这个概念包括这样的事情，即万物有灵论的野蛮人或野蛮人由于真正的或推定的发起行动的习惯而令人畏惧。
chunks: The concept includes such things
as in the apprehension of the animistic savage
or barbarian are formidable
by virtue of a real
or imputed habit of initiating action.

text: Wherever the unsophisticated savage or barbarian meets with activity that is at all obtrusive, he construes it in the only terms that are ready to hand--the terms immediately given in his consciousness of his own actions.
zh: 无论什么时候，纯朴的野蛮人或野蛮人遇到任何令人唐突的活动时，他都会用唯一可用的术语来解释它——这些术语是在他对自己的行为的意识中立即给出的。
chunks: Wherever the unsophisticated savage or barbarian meets
with activity that is at all obtrusive, he construes it
in the only terms that are ready
to hand--the terms immediately given
in his consciousness of his own actions.

text: We still speak of "brute matter" with something of the barbarian's realisation of a profound significance in the term.
zh: 我们仍然在谈论“野蛮物质”时，野蛮人意识到了这个词的深刻意义。
chunks: We still speak
of "brute matter" with something
of the barbarian's realisation
of a profound significance
in the term.

text: A cumulative process of selective adaptation to the new distribution of employments will set in, especially if the habitat or the fauna with which the group is in contact is such as to call for a considerable exercise of the sturdier virtues.
chunks: A cumulative process of selective adaptation
to the new distribution of employments will set in,
especially if the habitat or the fauna
with which the group is in contact is such as
to call for a considerable exercise of the sturdier virtues.

text: But the men's hunting and fighting are both of the same general character.
zh: 但男人的狩猎和打斗却具有相同的共同特征。
chunks: But the men's hunting
and fighting are both of the same general character.

text: As has already been indicated, the distinction between exploit and drudgery is an invidious distinction between employments.
zh: 正如已经指出的，剥削和苦役之间的区别是就业之间令人不快的区别。
chunks: As has already been indicated,
the distinction
between exploit
and drudgery is an invidious distinction
between employments.

text: He is, in his own apprehension, a centre of unfolding impulsive activity--"teleological" activity.
zh: 按照他自己的理解，他是正在展开的冲动活动——“目的论”活动的中心。
chunks: He is,
in his own apprehension,
a centre
of unfolding impulsive activity--"teleological" activity.

text: In any community where such an invidious comparison of persons is habitually made, visible success becomes an end sought for its own utility as a basis of esteem.
zh: 在任何习惯于对人进行这种令人不快的比较的社会中，可见的成功就成为其作为尊重基础的功利性追求的目标。
chunks: In any community where such an invidious comparison
of persons is habitually made,
visible success becomes an end sought
for its own utility
as a basis of esteem.

text: At the same time the incentive to emulation is not strong, nor is the scope for emulation large.
zh: 同时，竞争的动力不强，竞争的范围也不大。
chunks: At the same time the incentive
to emulation is not strong,
nor is the scope
for emulation large.

text: Aggression becomes the accredited form of action, and booty serves as prima facie evidence of successful aggression.
zh: 侵略成为公认的行动形式，而战利品则是成功侵略的初步证据。
chunks: Aggression becomes the accredited form
of action,
and booty serves
as prima facie evidence
of successful aggression.

text: Labour acquires a character of irksomeness by virtue of the indignity imputed to it.
zh: 劳动由于受到侮辱而具有令人厌烦的特征。
chunks: Labour acquires a character
of irksomeness by virtue of the indignity imputed to it.

text: This holds true to an extent also in the more civilised communities of the present day.
zh: 这在一定程度上也适用于当今较为文明的社区。
chunks: This holds true
to an extent also in the more civilised communities of the present day.

text: At the same time, employment in industry becomes correspondingly odious, and, in the common-sense apprehension, the handling of the tools and implements of industry falls beneath the dignity of able-bodied men.
zh: 与此同时，工业中的就业也相应地变得令人厌恶，而且，从常识来看，工业工具和工具的使用有损于身体健全的人的尊严。
chunks: At the same time,
employment in industry becomes correspondingly odious, and,
in the common-sense apprehension,
the handling of the tools and implements
of industry falls beneath the dignity of able-bodied men.

text: The known habits of primitive groups, as well as the habits of the anthropoid apes, argue to that effect, and the evidence from the well-known promptings of human nature enforces the same view.
zh: 原始群体的已知习惯以及类人猿的习惯都证明了这一点，而来自众所周知的人性提示的证据也强化了同样的观点。
chunks: The known habits of primitive groups, as well
as the habits of the anthropoid apes,
argue to that effect, and the evidence
from the well-known promptings
of human nature enforces the same view.

text: The inferior limit of the predatory culture is an industrial limit.
zh: 掠夺性文化的劣势极限是工业极限。
chunks: The inferior limit
of the predatory culture is an industrial limit.

text: A group may evidently attain such a predatory attitude with a greater or less degree of completeness, so that its scheme of life and canons of conduct may be controlled to a greater or less extent by the predatory animus.
zh: 一个群体显然可能或多或少地获得了这种掠夺性态度，其完整性程度不同，因此其生活方式和行为准则可能或多或少受到掠夺性敌意的控制。
chunks: A group may evidently attain such a predatory attitude
with a greater or less degree of completeness,
so that its scheme of life and canons
of conduct may be controlled
to a greater or less extent by the predatory animus.

text: In the inchoate phase of their development they are but different aspects of the same general facts of social structure.
zh: 在其发展的早期阶段，它们只不过是社会结构的同一普遍事实的不同方面。
chunks: In the inchoate phase
of their development they are
but different aspects
of the same general facts
of social structure.

text: Likewise the earliest form of ownership is an ownership of the women by the able bodied men of the community.
zh: 同样，最早的所有权形式是社区中身体健全的男性对妇女的所有权。
chunks: Likewise the earliest form
of ownership is an ownership
of the women
by the able bodied men
of the community.

text: The habitual appropriation and consumption of certain slight personal effects goes on without raising the question of ownership; that is to say, the question of a conventional, equitable claim to extraneous things.
zh: 习惯性地占有和消费某些轻微的个人物品并没有引起所有权问题；也就是说，对无关事物的传统的、公平的主张的问题。
chunks: The habitual appropriation and consumption
of certain slight personal effects goes
on without raising the question
of ownership; that is to say, the question
of a conventional, equitable claim to extraneous things.

text: The outcome of emulation under the circumstances of a predatory life, therefore, has been on the one hand a form of marriage resting on coercion, and on the other hand the custom of ownership.
zh: 因此，在掠夺性生活的情况下，竞争的结果一方面是一种基于强制的婚姻形式，另一方面是所有权的习俗。
chunks: The outcome of emulation under the circumstances
of a predatory life, therefore, has been
on the one hand a form
of marriage resting on coercion,
and on the other hand the custom of ownership.

text: Wherever the institution of private property is found, even in a slightly developed form, the economic process bears the character of a struggle between men for the possession of goods.
zh: 凡是有私有财产制度的地方，即使是稍微发达的形式，经济过程也带有人们之间争夺商品占有权的特征。
chunks: Wherever the institution of private property is found,
even in a slightly developed form,
the economic process bears the character
of a struggle between men
for the possession of goods.

text: Industrial efficiency is presently carried to such a pitch as to afford something appreciably more than a bare livelihood to those engaged in the industrial process.
zh: 目前，工业效率已达到这样的程度，即为从事工业过程的人们提供的东西远远超出了勉强的生计。
chunks: Industrial efficiency is presently carried
to such a pitch
as to afford something appreciably more
than a bare livelihood to those engaged
in the industrial process.

text: The possession of wealth confers honour; it is an invidious distinction.
zh: 拥有财富可以带来荣誉；这是一种令人不快的区别。
chunks: The possession
of wealth confers honour;
it is an invidious distinction.

text: The dominant incentive was from the outset the invidious distinction attaching to wealth, and, save temporarily and by exception, no other motive has usurped the primacy at any later stage of the development.
zh: 从一开始，主要的动机就是对财富的不公平的区分，而且，除了暂时的和例外的情况外，没有其他动机在发展的任何后期阶段篡夺了首要地位。
chunks: The dominant incentive was
from the outset the invidious distinction attaching
to wealth, and, save temporarily and by exception,
no other motive has usurped the primacy
at any later stage of the development.

text: This appreciation of exploit from the communal point of view is met with also at later stages of social growth, especially as regards the laurels of war.
zh: 在社会发展的后期阶段，也会遇到这种从公共角度来欣赏剥削的情况，特别是在战争的功劳方面。
chunks: This appreciation of exploit from the communal point
of view is met
with also at later stages
of social growth,
especially as regards the laurels of war.

text: Gradually, as industrial activity further displaced predatory activity in the community's everyday life and in men's habits of thought, accumulated property more and more replaces trophies of predatory exploit as the conventional exponent of prepotence and success.
chunks: Gradually, as industrial activity further displaced predatory activity
in the community's everyday life and in men's habits
of thought, accumulated property more
and more replaces trophies of predatory exploit
as the conventional exponent of prepotence and success.

text: It becomes indispensable to accumulate, to acquire property, in order to retain one's good name.
zh: 为了保持一个人的好名声，积累、获得财产就变得必不可少。
chunks: It becomes indispensable
to accumulate,
to acquire property,
in order
to retain one's good name.

text: Prowess and exploit may still remain the basis of award of the highest popular esteem, although the possession of wealth has become the basis of common place reputability and of a blameless social standing.
zh: 尽管拥有财富已成为普通声誉和无可指责的社会地位的基础，但英勇和功绩可能仍然是获得最高人民尊重的基础。
chunks: Prowess and exploit may still remain the basis
of award of the highest popular esteem,
although the possession of wealth has become the basis
of common place reputability
and of a blameless social standing.

text: Apparent exceptions to the rule are met with, especially among people with strong religious convictions.
zh: 这条规则也存在明显的例外情况，特别是在有强烈宗教信仰的人中。
chunks: Apparent exceptions
to the rule are met with,
especially among people
with strong religious convictions.

text: The tendency in any case is constantly to make the present pecuniary standard the point of departure for a fresh increase of wealth; and this in turn gives rise to a new standard of sufficiency and a new pecuniary classification of one's self as compared with one's neighbours.
chunks: The tendency in any case is constantly
to make the present pecuniary standard the point of departure for a fresh increase
of wealth; and this in turn gives rise
to a new standard of sufficiency and a new pecuniary classification
of one's self as compared with one's neighbours.

text: The desire for added comfort and security from want is present as a motive at every stage of the process of accumulation in a modern industrial community; although the standard of sufficiency in these respects is in turn greatly affected by the habit of pecuniary emulation.
chunks: The desire for added comfort and security from want is present
as a motive at every stage
of the process of accumulation in a modern industrial community;
although the standard of sufficiency in these respects is in turn greatly affected
by the habit of pecuniary emulation.

text: The propensity changes only in the form of its expression and in the proximate objects to which it directs the man's activity.
zh: 倾向仅在其表达形式以及其将人的活动引导到的最近对象上发生变化。
chunks: The propensity changes only
in the form
of its expression
and in the proximate objects
to which it directs the man's activity.

text: In making use of the term "invidious", it may perhaps be unnecessary to remark, there is no intention to extol or depreciate, or to commend or deplore any of the phenomena which the word is used to characterise.
zh: 在使用“令人厌恶的”一词时，也许没有必要说明，无意赞扬或贬低、赞扬或谴责该词所描述的任何现象。
chunks: In making use of the term "invidious",
it may perhaps be unnecessary
to remark, there is no intention to extol or depreciate,
or to commend or deplore any of the phenomena
which the word is used to characterise.

text: These lower classes can in any case not avoid labour, and the imputation of labour is therefore not greatly derogatory to them, at least not within their class.
zh: 这些下层阶级无论如何都无法避免劳动，因此，劳动的归咎对他们来说并没有太大的贬损，至少在他们的阶级内部是这样。
chunks: These lower classes can
in any case not avoid labour,
and the imputation
of labour is therefore not greatly derogatory
to them, at least not within their class.

text: The most imperative of these secondary demands of emulation, as well as the one of widest scope, is the requirement of abstention from productive work.
zh: 这些模仿的次要要求中最重要也是最广泛的要求是放弃生产性工作的要求。
chunks: The most imperative of these secondary demands
of emulation, as well
as the one of widest scope,
is the requirement of abstention
from productive work.

text: In order to gain and to hold the esteem of men it is not sufficient merely to possess wealth or power.
zh: 为了赢得并保持人们的尊重，仅仅拥有财富或权力是不够的。
chunks: In order to gain
and to hold the esteem
of men it is not sufficient merely
to possess wealth
or power.

text: So much so that there are few of the better class who are not possessed of an instinctive repugnance for the vulgar forms of labour.
zh: 正因如此，上层阶级中很少有人不本能地厌恶庸俗的劳动形式。
chunks: So much so that there are few
of the better class
who are not possessed
of an instinctive repugnance
for the vulgar forms of labour.

text: In itself and in its consequences the life of leisure is beautiful and ennobling in all civilised men's eyes.
zh: 在所有文明人眼中，休闲生活本身及其后果都是美丽而高尚的。
chunks: In itself
and in its consequences the life
of leisure is beautiful
and ennobling
in all civilised men's eyes.

text: Habits of industry and thrift, therefore, are not uniformly furthered by a prevailing pecuniary emulation.
zh: 因此，普遍的金钱竞争并不能一致地促进勤劳和节俭的习惯。
chunks: Habits of industry
and thrift, therefore,
are not uniformly furthered
by a prevailing pecuniary emulation.

text: And it is to be remarked that while the leisure class existed in theory from the beginning of predatory culture, the institution takes on a new and fuller meaning with the transition from the predatory to the next succeeding pecuniary stage of culture.
chunks: And it is to be remarked
that while the leisure class existed in theory from the beginning
of predatory culture, the institution takes on a new and fuller meaning
with the transition from the predatory
to the next succeeding pecuniary stage of culture.

text: The normal and characteristic occupations of the class in this mature phase of its life history are in form very much the same as in its earlier days.
zh: 在其生活史的成熟阶段，该阶级的正常和特有的职业在形式上与早期非常相似。
chunks: The normal and characteristic occupations
of the class in this mature phase
of its life history are
in form very much the same
as in its earlier days.

text: Something similar may be said of the chase, but with a difference.
zh: 追逐也可以说类似的话，但有所不同。
chunks: Something similar may be said
of the chase,
but with a difference.

text: Abstention from labour is not only a honorific or meritorious act, but it presently comes to be a requisite of decency.
zh: 放弃劳动不仅是一种光荣或有功绩的行为，而且现在已成为一种体面的必要条件。
chunks: Abstention from labour is not only a honorific
or meritorious act,
but it presently comes
to be a requisite
of decency.

text: This tabu on labour has a further consequence in the industrial differentiation of classes.
zh: 这种对劳动的禁忌进一步导致了阶级的产业分化。
chunks: This tabu
on labour has a further consequence in the industrial differentiation of classes.

text: This pervading sense of the indignity of the slightest manual labour is familiar to all civilized peoples, as well as to peoples of a less advanced pecuniary culture.
zh: 这种对最轻微体力劳动的侮辱的普遍感觉是所有文明民族以及金钱文化不太发达的民族所熟悉的。
chunks: This pervading sense of the indignity
of the slightest manual labour is familiar
to all civilized peoples,
as well as to peoples
of a less advanced pecuniary culture.

text: Polynesian chiefs is truer to the canon of honorific leisure than would at first appear.
zh: 波利尼西亚酋长们比乍一看更忠实于荣誉休闲的准则。
chunks: Polynesian chiefs is truer
to the canon of honorific leisure than would at first appear.

text: What it connotes is non-productive consumption of time.
zh: 它的含义是时间的非生产性消耗。
chunks: What it connotes is non-productive consumption
of time.

text: This can be done only indirectly, through the exhibition of some tangible, lasting results of the leisure so spent--in a manner analogous to the familiar exhibition of tangible, lasting products of the labour performed for the gentleman of leisure by handicraftsmen and servants in his employ.
chunks: This can be done only indirectly, through the exhibition of some tangible, lasting results
of the leisure so spent--in a manner analogous
to the familiar exhibition of tangible, lasting products
of the labour performed for the gentleman
of leisure by handicraftsmen and servants in his employ.

text: The criteria of a past performance of leisure therefore commonly take the form of "immaterial" goods.
